description: Complete flow for syncing note edits from user input to persistence

sequence.action: Captures BlockNote editor changes, calls debouncedSave with blocks
Debounced callback with 500ms delay, calls updateNote with noteId and blocks
Validates note exists, extracts title from blocks, prepares updates
Persists note changes to IndexedDB (Dexie) - PRIMARY STORAGE
Updates local Zustand state with new note data
If content changed and projectId exists, triggers FSA auto-save with 2s debounce
Sets 2000ms debounce timer for FSA file sync
Converts note to markdown, generates file path, writes to filesystem
Converts BlockNote blocks to Markdown with YAML frontmatter
Writes markdown file to filesystem via FileSystem Access API - DESKTOP ONLY
Triggers RAG indexing for the updated note (background process)

transaction_boundary.note: Dexie wraps each operation in implicit transaction; no explicit transaction() calls found

invariant_assumptions.assumption: Note ID remains constant throughout update lifecycle
invariant_assumptions.enforced_by: note-crud-slice.ts:198 - uses params.id for all operations

invariant_assumptions.assumption: Dexie operations are atomic per record
invariant_assumptions.enforced_by: Dexie.js library - implicit transaction per operation

invariant_assumptions.assumption: FSA sync is optional and non-blocking for core persistence
IndexedDB is source of truth for note data
invariant_assumptions.enforced_by: ADR-033 - Mobile uses IndexedDB only, FSA is sync target

invariant_assumptions.assumption: BlockNote blocks can be serialized to JSON and back

failure_points.condition: db.notes.update() throws error (quota exceeded, transaction aborted)
failure_points.result: saveStatus set to 'error', error message stored in state

failure_points.condition: FileSystem Access API permission denied or handle revoked
failure_points.result: Error logged, note remains in IndexedDB (data not lost)

failure_points.condition: User edits note then closes app before 500ms debounce completes
failure_points.result: Unsaved changes lost - no persistence before debounce fires

failure_points.condition: currentProjectId is null or triggerAutoSave handler not registered
failure_points.result: FSA sync skipped, note persists only in IndexedDB

failure_points.condition: simultaneous edits on same note from multiple tabs/devices
failure_points.result: last-write-wins applies; no merge dialog without manual strategy

failure_points.condition: BlockNote blocks contain unsupported content types
failure_points.result: Partial export or data loss in markdown file (IndexedDB retains full data)
